purpose: Provide a ready-to-run owner-local, fixed read-only catalog and binding inspector, replacing manual SQL snippets without activating commands or manufacturing runtime acceptance.
constraints: Inspect only: no business rows, DML, DDL, reservation, allocator, COMMIT, arbitrary SQL, native DLL execution, impersonated sessions or production activation. Owner runs the verified package later; no private target execution in development/CI.

Compile-link only unchanged current ServerConfiguration.cs and SqlDevelopmentTestTlsTarget.cs with exact input hashes; no application or writer assembly references, no production source or solution edits. Use pinned SqlClient and existing exact development TLS target policy; reject inherited connection/target overrides and preserve private config unchanged.

Fixed catalog-first visibility, exact shape/key/FK/check/default/trigger/durability evidence for purchase and inbound prerequisites, including complete17-column inbound journal. Inadequate visibility, missing/ambiguous metadata or unproved predicate semantics remain BLOCKED/UNKNOWN. Never install or repair schema automatically.

Optional expected binding comes only from explicit owner-local options, never generated or invented. Missing expectation stays blocked while safe inspection can continue. Report only allowlisted status/version/hash/failure codes; no connection strings, credentials, private paths, raw SQL definitions, binding values, customer rows or exception messages.

Native login/grant/session/document behavior, concurrency, commit durability, numbering, Send rights and runtime qualification remain NOT_RUN; passing metadata checks never creates RuntimeAcceptance or sets runtimeQualified.

Use an isolated test project and explicit locked restore/build/test steps in both existing backend workflows, with separate results paths/names and unchanged existing gates/permissions. Package compiled portable inspector with deterministic complete inventory and exact source/tree/config-input hashes under a distinct artifact name.

Synthetic recording/config/secret-canary/cleanup/cancellation and package-integrity tests required. No real owner SQL in CI. Root alone publishes; independent source/privacy review and exact-head/current-base hosted CI before merge.
